name: Q&A: A Light-Roasted Romance
source:
A kooky barista? A mysterious guest? A kranky robot? I wonder whose side you are on reader! Who you root for and which choices you make will determine how this story turns out, so get ready...

[From [url=https://wordofmouthgames.itch.io/qa-a-light-roasted-romance]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个古怪的咖啡师？神秘客人？一个脾气暴躁的机器人？我想知道读者你站在哪一边！你支持谁以及你做出哪些选择将决定这个故事的结局，所以准备好……

[来自[url=https://wordofmouthgames.itch.io/qa-a-light-roasted-romance]itch.io[/url]]
